title: 드론작전사령부령 / queue:ARTICLE:5:0:00005:part:1/1
full_text:
Article 5 (Duties of the Commander, etc.)
(1) Under the orders of the Chairman of the Joint Chiefs of Staff, the Commander shall exercise overall control over the affairs of the Command and direct and supervise the units assigned or attached to the Command.
(2) The Deputy Commander shall assist the Commander and shall act on the Commander's behalf where the Commander is unable to perform his or her duties due to unavoidable circumstances.
(3) The Chief of Staff shall assist the Commander and coordinate, control and supervise staff functions under the Commander's orders.
